extensionDescription.message: Rewrite URLs with regular expression rules. Redirects happen before the page loads.

options_lead.message: Register rules that rewrite URLs. They are evaluated from top to bottom, and the first matching rule is applied.

options_siteAccess_denied.message: Site access is not allowed. Allowing it is required to rewrite URLs.

options_siteAccess_failed.message: Could not allow site access. Allow it from the extension settings in your browser.

options_rules_hint.message: URLs matching the regular expression on the left are replaced with the URL on the right. Use the regular expression syntax accepted by DNR.

options_rules_bothRequired.message: Line $1: enter both the regular expression and the replacement URL.

options_rules_unsupported.message: The regular expression on line $1 is not supported: $2

options_playground_hint.message: Test saved rules in order, including redirect chains. Matching uses JavaScript and may differ from DNR. Checks stop after the number of saved rules.

options_playground_chainLimit.message: Error: The check stopped after $1 redirects; another rule still matches. This may indicate a loop or a longer chain.

options_playground_fragmentIgnored.message: Text after # is not part of the network request, so it is excluded from matching.

popup_description.message: Rewrite URLs with your saved rules.
